facts.statement: Data omitted by collection or filtering can exclude observations that matter to the intended prediction population.
Compare each category count divided by its population total between the supplied sample and target population to identify supported coverage differences.
For a category with known target membership, estimate inclusion probability as included category members divided by all target category members; an empty denominator cannot support a rate.
Unequal sampling probabilities affect the interpretation of a sample; a descriptive sample summary is not automatically representative of the target population.
Compute the arithmetic mean with np.mean(numeric_values) over the selected numeric observations.

Compute standard deviation with np.std(numeric_values, ddof=0), which divides squared deviations by N before taking the square root; use ddof=1 only when the stated calculation requires the N−1 divisor.

practice.objective: Using the supplied zone-A and zone-B order counts and selected numeric_values, calculate sample and target category proportions, category-specific inclusion probabilities, the arithmetic mean, and standard deviation with ddof=0. Record one coverage limitation supported by the counts.
practice.success: The results distinguish sample shares of 0.75 and 0.25 from target shares of 0.60 and 0.40 and inclusion probabilities of 0.50 and 0.25. Numeric summaries match the supplied observations and specified divisor. The recorded limitation identifies lower inclusion and sample share for zone B without claiming an unobserved cause or inevitable prediction failure.

live_code.required_skill: Use NumPy descriptive summaries and explicit numerator–denominator calculations to compare a supplied sample with its target population.
live_code.starter_state_intent: Provide NumPy already available, zone-A and zone-B sample counts of 30 and 10, target counts of 60 and 40, and a supplied numeric_values array for selected order observations. Leave result assignments and a written limitation incomplete. No ingestion or model operations are needed.
live_code.observable_success: Inspectable result variables contain the correct category shares, inclusion rates, mean, and ddof=0 standard deviation. Inclusion calculations are conditional on a positive target-category denominator; an empty denominator is recorded as unsupported rather than assigned a rate. A string records the supported zone-B coverage limitation.
